'''Kanon''' is a female NPC student found gossiping about the [[Black Shores]] with her fellow schoolmate, '''Kazuha'''. They can be found during the day down below the pathway of Spacetrek Archive.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Kanon:''' I heard there's another Black Shores member enrolling!
:'''Kazuha:''' Haven't we always had Black Shores students? What's so special about this one?
:'''Kanon:''' No, no, this one's different! {{MC|m=His|f=Her}} background is super mysterious...
:'''Kanon:''' Someone said {{MC|m=he|f=she}} was involved in the Threnodian revival in Jinzhou and Rinascita. Doesn't that scream "trouble magnet"?
:'''Kazuha:''' That's backwards causality. And isn't Black Shores a legit rescue organization?
:'''Kanon:''' Then what about the [[Encore|little girl]] who talks to puppets all day? Or that "[[Camellya|Lady Flora]]" who fights everywhere she goes? Or the "[[Galbrena|Demon]]" who feeds on Tacet Discords? A normal organization doesn't have that many weirdos, right?
:'''Kanon:''' And their leader... There's zero info even in the Archives. Doesn't that seem super shady?!
:'''Kanon:''' It's just like those TV dramas where the villain goes to lay low in a peaceful campus...
:'''Kazuha:''' You're jst overthinking it. Why not just ask a Black Shores student?
:'''Kanon:''' Fool! They've probably all signed NDAs, just like us!
:'''Kanon:''' Shhh, we probably shouldn't be talking about it. What if they're already listening...? 
{{Dialogue End}}
